capabilities: Convert Chinese punctuation to English Markdown punctuation while typing
Auto-pair backticks and skip past the closing backtick
Batch-convert selection, current line, or whole document via commands
Configure a custom punctuation mapping table in settings
Exclude files by folder path or extension from conversion
extras: No prebuilt release is mentioned; installation requires building the plugin from source with Node.js ≥ 18.
intentEvidence: an upgraded, generalized version of the dot-to-backtick plugin
motivation: The author built it to reduce the cost of switching between Chinese and English input methods while typing.
problem: Typing Markdown punctuation under a Chinese input method requires constant IME switching, and the interpunct · collides with the backtick used for inline code.

relations.evidence: an upgraded, generalized version of the dot-to-backtick plugin

summary: A Chinese-punctuation-to-Markdown converter that turns IME characters like · into backticks while typing, with context awareness, auto-pairing, and batch commands.
